## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the research-writing workflow it improves.

## Verification

- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] Relevant manual workflow checked
- [ ] Documentation/examples updated when public behavior changed

## Security and evidence

- [ ] No API keys, unpublished manuscripts, private Zotero records, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Claims about paper quality, theorem validity, or experimental results are bounded by evidence.
